stories.title: Synthetic Context Compiler Separates Evidence from Generation

evidence.claim: A staged context compiler validates evidence before generation and emits a bounded context packet.

stories.selection_reason: Exercises a pipeline-style technical mechanism with deterministic validation boundaries.

stories.title: Synthetic Agent Workbench Turns Review Feedback into Reusable Skills

evidence.claim: A feedback loop converts reviewed task outcomes into versioned reusable agent skills with explicit acceptance gates.

stories.selection_reason: Exercises a control-loop agent mechanism and reader-facing reusable-skill framing.
